scale: Founded 1997; two offices (Maadi, Cairo and Alexandria); manufacturer/installer of aluminum systems
fitReason: Long-established aluminum door/window and curtain-wall contractor whose door, hinged and sliding systems need handles, hinges and locks.
angle: Pitch aluminum-door lever handles, hinges, patch fittings and mortise/multipoint locks as an OEM hardware supplier to complement their aluminum systems on projects.
risk: Aluminum-system hardware is often tied to the profile supplier (e.g. European systems), which may constrain switching to a new lock source.
